name: Cross-platform FOSS Rainbow Six Siege remake in Godot

mentions.name: Cross-platform FOSS Rainbow Six Siege remake in Godot
mentions.description: A game that rebuilds Rainbow Six Siege in Godot with cross-platform compatibility (including Linux) and possibly FOSS licensing, so players can run siege matches together without depending on Ubisoft's kernel-level anti-cheat.
mentions.problem: Ubisoft will not support Linux because the game relies on kernel-level anti-cheat.
mentions.audience: Players who want to run Siege-like matches on Linux and play together with friends
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm rebuilding rainbow six siege but cross-compatible (and possibly FOSS?) in Godot.
mentions.author: ramon156
